feedback.goal: Audit getstackit/sortit, UniPat-AI/SaaS-Bench, and UniPat-AI/EvoCodeBench for proposer and evaluation inspiration, with pinned identities and file:line evidence, and persist a decision-grade synthesis plus roadmap hooks.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The three repos are cloned into ~/Workspace and pinned (sortit@c523150, SaaS-Bench@48c22de, EvoCodeBench@f8fcfaa).
The Rubic question is resolved with negative evidence: no Rubic/judge component exists in either UniPat repo or the benchmark pages; judging is deterministic per-task/per-step verifiers.

A ranked borrow list with file:line anchors lands in the research note (weighted/gated verifier protocol, evaluator-artifact isolation checklist, soft relevance+negation+specificity proposer ranking, pass@k unions, retrieval shortlisting) plus roadmap hooks.
Capsule digests refreshed and the full gate passes.

outcome.summary: Audit completed and persisted: sortit contributes proposer ranking ideas (soft relevance, negation, specificity, retrieval shortlisting); SaaS-Bench contributes the weighted/gated deterministic verifier protocol and variance-aware aggregation; EvoCodeBench contributes a citable evaluator-isolation incident. Rubic itself is not open-sourced.

what_worked: Parallel read-only deep dives plus main-thread source reading converged on the same mechanism claims with file:line anchors.
The Rubic gap was established as negative evidence rather than assumed away.
The EvoCodeBench Harbor verifier leak is now a citable real-world precedent for our evaluator-isolation anchor.
what_failed: Two of three parallel investigators were still running after three goal rounds and were interrupted; the synthesis used the delivered SaaS-Bench report plus main-thread evidence for sortit and EvoCodeBench.

calls.name: clone-and-inspect
calls.purpose: Clone the three repos at pinned commits and read the core scoring/evaluation files.

calls.name: docs-update
calls.purpose: Persist the audit section and roadmap hooks; refresh capsule digests; run the gate.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: The sortit and EvoCodeBench investigators exceeded three goal rounds without delivering; interrupted and replaced with main-thread evidence.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Their claims were covered independently by main-thread reads with file:line anchors; no evidence gap remains for the memo.

evidence.summary: New audit section: pinned identities, the Rubic negative-evidence finding, per-source mechanism tables, and a ranked borrow list with file:line anchors.
Typecheck, build, 134 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed.

uncertainty.statement: Rubic could exist in UniPat's non-public tooling or under a different name; the audit establishes only that it is absent from the public repos and pages.
uncertainty.resolution: If Rubic is ever open-sourced, re-audit it against the same evidence contract; the verifier-protocol borrow list stands regardless.

notes: Research and documentation only; no model calls, code behavior changes, or external transfers.
